row.name: Insight Enterprises Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)
checks.note: today would be breakout 4 of this move

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=3 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.14 tightness=0.61 base_volume_vs_leg=0.57 base_volume_vs_avg=0.63
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 7.7% vs its 20-SMA, 5.6% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 3 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The checklist flags this as breakout 4 of the same move that started 54 sessions ago with a 55.9% gain — the chart confirms it: you can count at least three prior range-expansion thrusts out of bases since early May, each one stepping higher along the same rising channel. A fourth push at this stage means the early buyers are sitting on large gains and have every reason to sell into this strength. The base itself is only three bars and looks tight, and the burst bar is clean, but the trend-age problem is decisive and visible.
claude.key_risk: Three prior breakouts in the same move means distribution risk is high; any broad-market softness will find motivated sellers at these levels.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the entry ceiling or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back below the prior day's close (~154).

row.summary: NSIT: +6.1% on 1.5× volume out of a base 4.8% deep. C 8.5, 5 of 6 criteria.
